address: 1 rue de la Brosse, Le Subdray, 18570, France
bio: In a small village about 15km from Bourges, this restaurant run by a young couple is definitely one to recommend. Everything is home-made, most of the vegetables come from the garden, and freshness is the order of the day. Simple menu at lunchtime during the week, more elaborate options on the dinner menu and at weekends....
